title: docs(lite): fix idd-review-snapshot-lite's inverted F3 digest carve-out
body:
<!-- idd-skill-authoring-publication: target=target-0f0c65aa4c356a86; anchor=kurone-kito/idd-skill#2770; set=set-449631721ec618b2; session=claude-fable-4e5f865d; token=pub-62fd32065f021dff -->

## Background

Part of the `spec-audit-2026-09-09` roadmap (R2, phase-digest rules;
raised by 2 of 3 audit passes).

`.github/instructions/lite/idd-review-snapshot-lite.instructions.md`
Step 2 ("Record the watermark", around lines 174-178) says:

> Do not create or edit the PR live status digest after posting this
> watermark unless the next route is back to E1, an F3 blocked reroute
> that **returns to** F2's restart path, a hold/stop, or post-merge
> cleanup

The standard file it condenses,
`.github/instructions/idd-review-snapshot.instructions.md` (around
lines 192-196; the `idd-template/` source sits five lines earlier, before
the generated-from banner), carves out the opposite branch:

> unless the next route is E1, an F3 blocked reroute that **leaves** the
> F2 restart path (F1/D4), a hold/stop, or post-merge cleanup

`idd-merge.instructions.md` F3 and `idd-overview-appendix.instructions.md`
both side with the standard file: a blocked reroute that goes back to
F2's restart path must not touch the digest, because a digest edit is
PR activity and would invalidate the review currency the restarted F2
pass is about to check. A lite-profile session following its own file
edits the digest on exactly the path where that edit self-invalidates
the next gate.

## Proposed change

- In the canonical
  `idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/idd-review-snapshot-lite.instructions.md`,
  replace "an F3 blocked reroute that returns to F2's restart path" with
  the standard file's "an F3 blocked reroute that leaves the F2 restart
  path (F1/D4)", keeping the rest of the sentence unchanged.
- Run `node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --apply` so the generated
  `.github/instructions/lite/` copy matches.

## Acceptance criteria

- `grep -n "returns to F2" .github/instructions/lite/idd-review-snapshot-lite.instructions.md`
  prints nothing, and the lite Step 2 sentence contains "leaves the F2
  restart path (F1/D4)".
- `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` and
  `npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"` pass.

## Candidate files

- `idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/idd-review-snapshot-lite.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/lite/idd-review-snapshot-lite.instructions.md`

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented. A one-clause replacement
with the target wording quoted from the canonical file._
